title: 正弦稳态下 T 形网络的 Z、Y 参数
statement: 图示 T 形二端口工作在 ω = 1000 rad/s 的正弦稳态下：L = 2 mH，C = 500 µF，R = 2 Ω。端口电流相量 İ1、İ2 都以流入端口为正。
求 Z 参数 z_11，再由 Z 参数换算出 Y 参数 y_11 和 y_21（复数）。

questions.ask: y_21 的实部 = ?（它的虚部为 0）

hints: 先算出 jωL 和 1/(jωC)，再像电阻 T 形网络一样写 Z 参数：z_11 = Z_L + R，z_22 = Z_C + R，z_12 = z_21 = R。

en.title: Z and Y parameters of a T network in AC steady state
statement: The T two-port operates in sinusoidal steady state at ω = 1000 rad/s: L = 2 mH, C = 500 µF, R = 2 Ω. Both port current phasors I_1, I_2 are positive into the port.
Find the Z parameter z_11, then convert the Z parameters to the Y parameters y_11 and y_21 (complex numbers).

questions.explain: jωL = j2 Ω, 1/(jωC) = −j2 Ω. With port 2 open, z_11 = j2 + 2 = 2 + j2 Ω, |z_11| = 2√2 ≈ 2.828 Ω (angle 45°).
y_11 = 0.5 − j0.5 S, imaginary part −0.5 S. Check: with port 2 shorted, port 1 sees Z = j2 + 2 ∥ (−j2) = j2 + (1 − j1) = 1 + j1 Ω, so y_11 = 1/(1 + j1) = 0.5 − j0.5 S.

questions.ask: Real part of y_21 = ? (its imaginary part is 0)
questions.explain: y_21 = −z_21/Δ_Z = −2/4 = −0.5 S (purely real). The network is reciprocal, y_12 = y_21 = −0.5 S, but z_11 ≠ z_22, so it is not symmetric.

hints: Compute jωL and 1/(jωC) first, then write the Z parameters as for a resistive T network: z_11 = Z_L + R, z_22 = Z_C + R, z_12 = z_21 = R.
Y = Z⁻¹: y_11 = z_22/Δ_Z, y_21 = −z_21/Δ_Z, with Δ_Z = z_11·z_22 − z_12·z_21. In complex arithmetic (2 + j2)(2 − j2) = 8.
solution: **2. Z parameters (open circuit).** z_11 = Z_L + R = **2 + j2 Ω (|z_11| ≈ 2.828 Ω)**, z_22 = Z_C + R = 2 − j2 Ω, z_12 = z_21 = R = 2 Ω.
**5. Check y_11 from its definition:** with port 2 shorted, R is in parallel with C: 2 ∥ (−j2) = 1 − j1 Ω; adding j2 Ω in series gives 1 + j1 Ω, so y_11 = 1/(1 + j1) = 0.5 − j0.5 S ✓.
